Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.behaviour

Record Class Provenance

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.behaviour.Provenance
Record Components:
source - the kind of source
reference - what exactly was read, e.g. CloudburstMC/Data@0021592... or the layer of a custom block
captured - the data version the source was captured for (older than version for an inherited value)
version - the data version the value was asked for
alternatives - the values other sources of the same version gave, when they differ from this one and nothing direct from BDS settles it; empty if the value is not disputed
postProcessing - how the source itself post-processed the value (e.g. door_state_correction: the dump's author corrected it after the BDS dump), or null if the source did not say so
public record Provenance(@NonNull Provenance.Source source, @NonNull String reference, @NonNull DataVersion captured, @NonNull DataVersion version, @NonNull List<Provenance.Alternative> alternatives, @Nullable String postProcessing) extends Record
Where a behaviour value comes from, and how far to trust it.

Values come from BDS itself wherever possible (Paletter's own captures: Provenance.Source.NATIVE, Provenance.Source.SCRIPT_API, Provenance.Source.BDS_PROBE, Provenance.Source.WIRE); third-party dumps of BDS (Provenance.Source.CLOUDBURST_DATA, Provenance.Source.ALLAY_DATA) rank below them and say so (thirdParty()); Provenance.Source has the ranking. Where sources disagree and no BDS evidence settles it, the value is disputed() and the other sources' values are in alternatives(): nothing is picked silently. Custom content says whether a value was set by the user (userSet()) or is a BDS default.

Since:
1.0.0
